title: A House Sparrow Has More Than One Daily Routine
caption:
From foraging among plants to dust and water baths: three genuine scenes of house sparrows filmed at separate locations. #WildVox #HouseSparrow #Birdwatching #Wildlife

narration_timeline.text: A female house sparrow searches between these leaves, stopping to inspect small patches of ground.
narration_timeline.scene: Actual female house sparrow foraging among plants

narration_timeline.text: Another sparrow appears beside a waterfront, where busy city spaces meet everyday bird life.
narration_timeline.scene: A real house sparrow beside an urban Ljubljana waterfront

narration_timeline.text: From a wider view, a sparrow appears beside a mossy stone border, pausing on the edge of a garden path.
narration_timeline.scene: Actual distant sparrow perched beside a mossy stone garden border; do not claim movement toward trees.

narration_timeline.text: But sparrows also take unusual baths, settling into dry soil and shaking their feathers through the dust.
narration_timeline.scene: Two original sparrow dust-bath clips, one in a flowerbed and another at zoo grounds

narration_timeline.text: Water offers another option, as other sparrows bathe near a pond and in a shared birdbath.
narration_timeline.scene: Real sparrow water-edge bathing and separate birdbath with other birds

narration_timeline.text: In one last zoo-ground scene, a sparrow rolls through the dust before continuing its day.
narration_timeline.scene: A genuine sparrow dust-bath scene in zoo grounds
